name: GoldNet
summary: Kalgoorlie ISP (Goldnet Internet Services, ACN 127 052 493); merged with Ludin to form Emerge Technologies 1999; took back the ISP side ~2013, continued to ~2015.

events.details: Final end of the GoldNet brand. goldnet.com.au stopped showing any GoldNet retail-ISP content between Feb 1999 and Sep 2000 (not c. 2015 as both current and proposal claim); the successor company is alive at gold.net.au as a carrier, so the entity is flagged still-active while the retail ISP died c. 2000. retail ISP base passed to Origin Internet; company survives as a carrier.

refs.label: Jan/Feb 1999: last GoldNet-branded retail-ISP captures on the domain (CDX shows Origin Internet occupying it next).
By 17 Sep 2000 goldnet.com.au served Bendigo-based Origin Internet (which was absorbing regional ISPs); the domain later became an SA gold-trading site (2005-11
Business still trades from gold.net.au (Perth/Kalgoorlie) as an enterprise telecom carrier - not a retail ISP.
